## Needs the Grok Bot app (cannot be automated here)

1. Create three Bots from [bots/](../bots/) first messages.
2. Share as template, strip secrets, paste URLs into [SHARE_LINKS.md](SHARE_LINKS.md).
3. List on [Grokyard](https://www.grokyard.com/about) (sign in, paste share URL).
4. Post the tweets in [X_POSTS.md](X_POSTS.md).
5. Request staff listing on https://x.ai/bot/marketplace after share links work.
